title: Current-mirror differential-pair bias
goal: A reader must be able to trace the diode-connected NPN current mirror into the common tail of a loaded differential pair.

rubric.must: Q1 and Q2 are both labelled 2N3904 and visibly share one base node labelled BBASE.
Q1 has its collector visibly tied to its base, with RREF leading from VCC into that node.
Q2’s collector connects to the single TAIL node shared by the emitters of Q3 and Q4.
VIN+ and VIN− feed separate bases of the two differential-pair transistors.
Each differential-pair collector has its own 2.2 kΩ load resistor to VCC.
The diagram visibly labels a 5 V VCC supply and a 4.3 kΩ, 1% reference resistor.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies all six rules, while the picture reverses the transistor numbering and omits required node labels, device types, and component values.
